justification: Both show the same standing monolithic figure with a rectangular head, vertically incised panels flanking the head, paired concentric rings above a large central ring on the torso, arcing bands below and a small boss near the base, in identical relative positions. The only differences are viewing angle and surroundings, not depicted content; this is to all appearances the same carved figure.
